name: After § 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text: 5b. Recalls that public funding of public service media providers must comply with EU State aid rules, including the requirement that public compensation be subject to clearly defined public service obligations, effective oversight mechanisms and transparent reporting, in order to ensure that such funding does not distort competition and remains compatible with the internal market;
